episode.title: The Five-Star Mix-Up
episode.premise: A romantic hotel misunderstanding turns into a playful luxury adventure.

shots.title: The Grand Arrival
shots.action: Luna and Leo arrive at a glamorous European hotel.

shots.title: The Wrong Key
shots.action: Leo realizes he has the key to the honeymoon suite next door.
shots.dialogue:
Leo: I can explain.
Luna: I hope so!

shots.title: The Look
shots.action: Luna gives Leo a teasing smile as the elevator doors close.
shots.dialogue: Luna: This holiday just got interesting.
